row.evidence: Usersnap's pricing table lists Single-sign-on & SAML (SAML or OIDC) only on Enterprise, and its help centre and API reference document no SCIM or provisioning endpoint.
row.notes: Still none, set by absence across the pricing page, the full help-centre index (llms.txt), the SSO and team guides and the OpenAPI spec. SSO (SAML/OIDC) is Enterprise only; the help centre calls it an add-on to Enterprise. Plans changed since June: Starter $49, Growth $129, Professional $209, Premium $449 per month billed yearly in USD (flat, Growth and up have unlimited seats), Enterprise custom; June's 'Startup $69-$99' tier no longer exists. REST API (Premium+) covers feedback only, no user management. Okta: no OIN app, custom SAML/OIDC app only.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere: the help-centre index (llms.txt), SSO guide, team-management guide, REST API guide and OpenAPI spec never mention SCIM or provisioning. Set by absence, not by an explicit 'no'.

capabilities.notes: False here means absent from the published OpenAPI spec, which lists only project and feedback endpoints.

endpoints.purpose: List assignees of a project (read-only; not user management)

limitations.text: REST API is a gated feature (Premium and Enterprise on the pricing table) and has no team-member management.

user_api.notes: A REST API exists (Premium and Enterprise per the pricing table) but covers projects and feedback only; the OpenAPI spec has no user, team or member endpoints. The only user-related read is GET /projects/{api_key}/assignees.

okta.notes: https://www.okta.com/integrations/usersnap/ returned 404; Usersnap's SSO guide has customers create a custom SAML/OIDC app in Okta.

fallbacks.notes: Team members join only by email invitation from the team admin; no CSV or directory import is documented (csv_import false by absence).
